title: A docs-only change to README.md or kb/_self/reports/ says up front that it takes the code lane and which docs its map makes stale
goal: The orchestrator learns before its commit that a README.md or kb/_self/reports/*.md change goes through a code/<id> merge request and which kb/_self docs selfdoc maps it to, so done is not refused for an unmerged lane commit or a stale doc it could have named
notes: SP-ciqk6gt6 close: done ST-wrsuz64a was refused once (README.md commit not on origin/main, alternatives.md stale) and done TK-ew6dsm2l once (the report commit not on origin/main; design.md and token-efficiency.md stale through the kb/_self/reports/*.md map rows).
